cues.text: The top of Tartarus, a round platform ringed by pillars with bird statues. You walk onto it with the team; everyone looks up.
Feathers peel from the statues and swirl upward.
Streams of feathers rise from every statue, higher and higher, and converge on a huge full moon, knotting together at its centre.
In front of the moon the feathers churn into a tangled mass, and something bursts out of it, spreading great feathered wings.
A slender figure with many wings grips a long blade. Its mask has hollow eyes and a fixed smile. It hovers high above you.
